status: auxiliary research delta, not adopted; no formal turn advanced
scope: 24 candidates or refinements; source-described methods and proposed applications distinguished; no measured uplift

items.name: Rival-model discrimination
items.mechanism: Compare plausible models and their distinct predictions; preserve inconclusive cases.
items.acceptance: Paired indistinguishable/discriminating cases produce justified abstention and correct discrimination.

items.name: Elimination and ablation
items.lineage: D11; v1.1 rival_models optional elimination; parallel review provenance correction
items.mechanism: Change one suspected cause; use a placebo and reproduce the original defect.
items.acceptance: Only targeted change removes the reproducible defect; placebo does not.

items.name: Assumption sensitivity thresholds
items.mechanism: Vary decision-driving assumptions within justified ranges and locate decision boundaries.
items.acceptance: A sign-changing case is qualified; a stable case reports tested range.

items.name: Analogical transfer mapping
items.mechanism: Bind source-target relationships, invariants, exceptions and tests.
items.acceptance: Held-out changed-domain case preserves invariant and rejects a false analogy.

items.name: Orthogonal numerical verification
items.mechanism: Use independent calculation, units or solved limit rather than duplicating assumptions.
items.acceptance: Detect shared-denominator error; accept a valid control.

items.name: Forecast resolution discipline
items.mechanism: Freeze issue time, input cutoff, horizon, resolution source and comparator.
items.acceptance: Late source excluded; unresolved stays unknown; resolved scores reproducible.

items.name: Decisive-observation selection
items.mechanism: Record conflicting or unknown evidence and the observation that would change a conclusion.
items.acceptance: New evidence updates only the claims it resolves.

items.name: Cross-representation semantic fidelity
items.mechanism: Check equivalent claims across figures, prose, data and machine outputs.
items.acceptance: Wrong denominator or changed conclusion is detected while valid alternate layout passes.

items.name: Alternative interpretation prototyping
items.mechanism: Develop two genuinely different treatments; allow rejection of both.
items.acceptance: Blind reader recovers intended meaning and distinguishes usable alternatives.

items.name: Hypothesis workbench
items.lineage: D24; parallel review says agent-proposed with source analogues
items.mechanism: Keep speculative objects distinct from factual claims and promotion criteria.
items.acceptance: Novel hypothesis can be explored; invented observation cannot enter supported results.

items.name: Best-of-N and candidate selection
items.mechanism: Compare multiple candidates against an explicit rubric and cost budget.
items.acceptance: Matched total resources; improvement over one stronger attempt must be measured.

items.name: Self-consistency and independent disagreement
items.lineage: Gold I; Claude findings G warns of false matches
items.mechanism: Compare multiple answers without treating agreement as proof.
items.acceptance: Include common-mode wrong consensus and valid minority answer.

items.name: Quality-diversity search
items.lineage: Gold I: novelty search and MAP-Elites
items.mechanism: Maintain distinct viable solution niches rather than only one highest score.
items.acceptance: Matched budget yields useful alternatives without degrading accepted quality.

items.name: Bounded branching / debate
items.lineage: Gold I: tree of thoughts and multi-agent debate
items.mechanism: Compare independently developed alternatives with explicit evidence and bounded branches.
items.acceptance: Blind evaluation measures correction, costs and shared errors; dissent retained.

items.name: Critique and revise
items.mechanism: Revise a candidate against a specific rubric with an explicit stopping condition.
items.acceptance: Compare error correction and regression against equal-resource baseline.

items.name: Four-arm harness evaluation
items.mechanism: Compare native, shadow, guided and release-guarded modes at matched resources.
items.acceptance: Retain blinded ratings, human rescues, costs, failures and baseline non-regression.

items.name: Rule scope, expiry and counterexamples
items.mechanism: Each restrictive rule has owner, scope, purpose, severity, review/expiry, counterexample and override.
items.acceptance: Expired project-specific restrictions not silently inherited; soft rule cannot become hard block.

items.name: Suppressed-path and scope ablation
items.mechanism: Ask what valid solution a rule forbids; compare with/without the disputed rule.
items.acceptance: Seed known viable paths and measure missed approaches and false stops.

items.name: Model routing under matched budget
items.mechanism: Allocate inexpensive methods/models to suitable tasks and escalate when justified.
items.acceptance: Measure cost per accepted output and error rates; escalate difficult cases.

items.name: Proof of harness adoption
items.mechanism: Distinguish declared methods, submitted evidence, linked run IDs and review closure.
items.acceptance: Compare linked and unlinked artifact commits; empty denominator stays unknown.

items.name: Structure-aware corpus screening
items.evidence_status: implemented heuristic scanner; ranking improvements proposed
items.mechanism: Shortlist by structure, method terms, mechanism coverage and per-file caps.
items.acceptance: Report unbiased held-out recall, missed leads and candidate reading workload.

items.name: Near-duplicate retrieval with source lineage
items.mechanism: Keep occurrence pointers when removing normalized exact or MinHash near duplicates from search shortlist.
items.acceptance: Same content at two locators remains traceable; distinct meaning not silently discarded.

items.name: Independent gold-set and miss audit
items.mechanism: Separate boosted screening from unboosted recall and audit false negatives on held-out material.
items.acceptance: Report recall@k and denominator without using the test anchors to tune retrieval.

items.name: Lineage versus semantic support
items.mechanism: Record exact source anchor, whether it supports the principle/procedure, and agent-added adaptation.
items.acceptance: Correctly locate but reject a passage that does not support the attributed method.
